name: task
title: Task
description: Something a person can get done here, with the page, flow or tool that does it.

files.props.yaml:
# A TASK'S OWN FIELDS: the door and the face, every one assigned from the asset's manifest or the Agent file.
whenToUse:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    The authored selection text, kept as the source the extraction read. Assigned from the
    manifest.
instructions:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    What to do: the steps the Agent follows while doing the task. Assigned from the Agent
    file.
skills:
  type: array
  input: false
  description: >-
    The skills the task requires, by name. Assigned from the Agent file.
  items:
    type: string
category:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    The domain of the job. Assigned from the manifest.
  maxLength: 64
version:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    The definition's version. Assigned from the manifest.
  maxLength: 32
task:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    unoverse://tasks/<org>/<name>, the row's identity. Assigned by the registry.
  maxLength: 200
app:
  description: >-
    The face: unoverse://components/<org>/<name>. Assigned from the manifest, default the
    agent card.
workflow:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    Door, workflow: the canvas id. Assigned from the Agent file.
  maxLength: 64
trigger:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    Door, workflow: the Input Trigger node id. Assigned from the Agent file.
  maxLength: 64
output:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    Door, workflow: the node whose output is the result. Assigned from the Agent file.
  maxLength: 64
message:
  type: string
  input: false
  description: >-
    What the face says while a workflow task runs. Assigned from the Agent file.
  maxLength: 200
inputSchema:
  type: object
  input: false
  description: >-
    The tool's input schema, as the manifest declares it. Assigned from the manifest.
autoTrigger:
  type: boolean
  input: false
  description: >-
    Whether the door fires on arrival. Assigned from the manifest.
files.task.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
# An outcome a person can get done, with a door: an interface to render, a workflow to run, or
# an MCP to call (docs/unoverse/data/objects/elements/task.md, ruled 2026-09-06). Not authored: an
# asset becomes a task when its Available switch is on; a bare Agent is the one file written
# for the map. Every task is a native MCP tool.
type: object
name: task
element: task
# THE GLYPH its rows are drawn with (README 4a): a lucide icon name.
icon: square-check
extends: need
uniqueBy: [task]
embed: [title, description, key_need, related_needs, questions, callToAction]
search: all
meta: open

# THE FACE, as a node's node.yaml carries it: what this is and when an Agent reaches for it.
title: Task
description: >-
  Something a person can get done here, with the page, flow or tool that does it.
whenToUse: >-
  Compare these for me. Work out what I spent. Help me find the right one. Help me apply. Do it for me.
category: Objects
version: 1.0.0

props: { $include: props }
